_doc: #1106 files allowed to touch androidx.security.crypto directly (EncryptedSharedPreferences.create / MasterKeys.getOrCreate / MasterKey.Builder). Everything else opens an encrypted prefs file through libs:crash SafeEncryptedPrefs, which never throws when the Keystore master key does not match the file (Cloud Drive crash, AEADBadTagException from GitCredentialStore). Each entry needs a reason.

allow.ab_cloud-libs-shared/libs/account/src/ma: EncryptedFile (the account slots), not EncryptedSharedPreferences; AccountStore already treats an unreadable slot as empty
allow.ac_cloud-gallery/app/src/main/kotlin/com: EncryptedFile for vault media, not EncryptedSharedPreferences
allow.ac_cloud-vault/data/src/main/kotlin/com/: Bitwarden's own module graph (no libs:crash on :data); it already catches the failure and destroys and rebuilds the master key and file
allow.ac_cloud-chat/libraries/@mattermost/secu: a vendored React Native library with its own gradle module, outside the fleet's module graph
allow.ab_cloud-libs-shared/libs/account-ui/src: Personal Info (IDs, cards): PersonalStore.repo already wraps the open in runCatching, so a Keystore mismatch cannot crash the app -- the pages say the store is locked. SafeEncryptedPrefs would instead delete the sealed file and carry on with an empty in-memory store, silently dropping the owner's documents instead of telling them.
